title: Prediction
description: Predict why Outlet is needed in a layout route.
prompt: What does Outlet do in a nested route layout?

options.label: It automatically loads data for every child route.
It marks where the matched child route should render.
It creates navigation links for child routes.

responses.loads-data: Not quite. Outlet is about rendering nested route content, not automatic data loading.
responses.renders-child: Correct. The parent layout stays visible and Outlet shows the matched child route.
responses.creates-link: Not quite. Links are created with Link or NavLink. Outlet renders child content.

metadata.reason: Catches the common confusion between layout rendering, links, and data loading.
